programs.name: Independent School
programs.description: Colorado Heritage serves as the school of record for all enrolled homeschool families. The annual enrollment fee covers record-keeping, official communication, and access to CHESS resources.

programs.name: K-12 Academy — Class Tuition
programs.description: Academy classes run for two 14-week semesters each year. Tuition covers per-class instruction and the annual school administration fee. A technology fee applies to every student enrolled in Academy classes.

fees.notes: All grade levels; per Study Hall
Required per student enrolled in Academy

programs.name: High School Diploma Program
programs.description: The CHESS Diploma Program provides a customizable 4-year high school plan with an official CHESS transcript, four diploma tracks, and an optional graduation ceremony. Transcript transfer fees apply for students with academic or homeschool records from other institutions.

programs.name: Testing Services
programs.description: CHESS offers several testing options for independent school and diploma program students. Sibling discounts apply when two students from the same family test at the same session.

fees.notes: $70/test for 2 students from same family, same session
$85/test for 2 students from same family, same session

programs.name: Non-Diploma Program Members
